specs.Video resolution: Panoramic: 8K (7680×3840), 6K (6000×3000). Single-lens: 4K (3840×2880 or 3840×2160), 2.7K. Boost Video also supports 4K 1:1 and 9:16.
specs.Shutter speed: Photo: 1/8000s to 30s. Video: 1/8000s to the limit of frames per second.
specs.Field of view: 360° panoramic capture; each fisheye lens captures over 180°.
specs.Frame rate: Panoramic 8K/6K: 24/25/30/48/50/60fps. Panoramic slow motion: 4K/100/200/240fps. Single-lens Boost Video: up to 4K/120fps. Vortex: up to 8K/120fps or 6K/200fps.
specs.Compatible sd card: microSD up to 1TB. Recommended U3 A2 V30 microSDXC models: Kingston CANVAS Go! Plus or Lexar Professional SILVER PLUS (64GB–1TB).
